name: Samyang Corporation
summary: Samyang Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of sugar and engineering plastics in Korea, China, Japan, rest of Asian countries, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Food, Chemicals, and Others. It supplies engineering plastic products including PC, PBT, TPEE, and M-PET, as well as compound products made from base materials, such as PC, PBT, PMMA, and PET for the automobile, electrical and electronic, medical, and security industries; and produces ion exchange resin for food, pharmaceuticals, semiconductors, and catalysts applications.
